newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Investor CEO heading for S-E-Banken - paper.
newsitem.headline: Investor CEO heading for S-E-Banken - paper.

text.p: The chief executive of Swedish investment company Investor, Claes Dahlback, is expected to assume a seat this year on the board of banking group S-E-Banken, a Swedish daily reported on Friday.
"Investor's current CEO Claes Dahlback...will at this year's annual general meeting be elected to S-E-Banken's board," business newspaper Dagens Industri said.
"The aim is for Claes Dahlback to be elected chairman of S-E-Banken at the 1998 annual general meeting."
Dahlback will then presumably be forced to leave Investor as Swedish corporate law prohibits the head of an investment company from also sitting on the board of a bank, the newspaper said.
Marcus Wallenberg, currently vice president of Investor and a nephew of board chairman Peter Wallenberg, could at that point become chief executive of Investor.
"The analysis is correct," Peter Wallenberg, the powerful family's head, was quoted as saying.

The moves follow a announcement on Thursday that Peter Wallenberg will step down from his chairman's post at Investor, the Wallenberg family's investment vehicle, to be replaced by Percy Barnevik, one of Sweden's top business leaders.
